verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for an AI assistant and API service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection, data residency options or regional storage controls for Kimi. The pack only shows a single international API server (api.moonshot.ai) with no residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
